column7: LocalStorage.UpdateGroup was a bare GORM Save of a struct read earlier and unlocked; Save's 0-rows fallback upserts with deleted_at=NULL, and DeleteGroup deliberately RETAINS a deleted group's GroupRole/UserGroup rows so RestoreGroup can work -- so a rename landing after a delete or SCIM deprovision brought the group back with every role grant and membership live, with no restore audit event and without going through RestoreGroup. An IdP DELETE followed closely by a PUT/PATCH is enough: core.UpdateGroup, ReplaceSCIMGroup and PatchSCIMGroup all renamed through this primitive, outside the withGroupProjectAdminGuardLocks that deleteGroupGuarded holds. Fixed by replacing it with UpdateGroupFields, a conditional column-scoped UPDATE of only the non-nil fields, scoped to deleted_at IS NULL, with the caller failing closed on no-match and re-reading the committed row. Red on real Postgres: the group row was live again and carried its still-present grants. Found by C-GUARD-3 guard 1
